newsitem.title: GERMANY: Six killed in German train accident.
newsitem.headline: Six killed in German train accident.

text.p: At least six people were killed in a train accident north of Frankfurt on Saturday when a 15-metre (yard) long metal pipe fell off a freight train and crashed into a passing passenger train, police said.
A spokesman said several other passengers were injured in the accident, which happened shortly before 9 a.m. (0700 GMT) near the town of Stadtallendorfs.
The police spokesman said it was not clear how or why the pipe broke loose from the freight train and sliced open one of the passenger waggons.
Stadtallendorfs is north of Frankfurt in western Germany and between Neustadt and Treysa.
Police had no further immediate details.
